_comment: The empty default the site ships with, and the fallback when nothing has been published yet.
This file is no longer where published builds are recorded. A build is published by posting
the .deb to /repo/publish, which measures those bytes and keeps the index in Netlify Blobs --
so the repository updates without a deploy, and without depending on a commit reaching a
branch this site does not deploy from. That last part is why an earlier design, which had CI
rewrite this file and push it, left the repository empty: the push went to the GitHub remote,
and the site deploys from Netlify's own hosted git.
What is still read from here is the repository's own identity -- the origin, label and
description below -- and the empty package list, so a package manager that adds the source
before the first build sees a repository with nothing in it rather than a 500.
label: LyricsTweak
description: Timed lyrics on the lock screen, Notification Center, Control Center and the fullscreen player, with a shared lyrics library for the songs no catalogue indexes.
